2608.21656.title: Mitigating Database Leakage in RAG Systems with Keyword-Grounded Fact Substitution
2608.21656.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for combining large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge sources. However, RAG systems remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks, which may mislead the retriever or generator to expose sensitive database contents. To address this issue, we propose KFS-RAG, a defense that mitigates information leakage by reformulating the retrieved context. Specifically, our method first identifies a small set of influential keywords from the retrieved context via an attention rollout plus a causal perturbation mechanism. These keywords are then used to guide an auxiliary LLM to generate a compact set of keyword-grounded facts from the retrieved passages. Finally, the original context is substituted with these curated facts, ensuring that the generator operates on sanitized evidence rather than the raw retrieved text. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that KFS-RAG significantly reduces the risk of database leakage under injection attacks while maintaining response accuracy and relevance. This work highlights a practical pathway toward building secure and trustworthy RAG systems.
2608.21656.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）已成為結合大型語言模型（LLMs）與外部知識來源的強大範式。<lb/>然而，RAG 系統仍然容易受到提示注入攻擊的影響，這可能會誤導檢索器或生成器暴露敏感的數據庫內容。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們提出了 KFS-RAG，一種通過重新構建檢索到的上下文來減輕信息洩漏的防禦方法。<lb/>具體而言，我們的方法首先通過注意力展開加上因果擾動機制來識別檢索上下文中的一小組影響關鍵詞。<lb/>然後，這些關鍵詞被用來指導輔助 LLM 從檢索的段落中生成一組緊湊的基於關鍵詞的事實。<lb/>最後，原始上下文被這些精選事實所替代，確保生成器在經過清理的證據上運行，而不是原始檢索文本。<lb/>實驗評估表明，KFS-RAG 在注入攻擊下顯著降低了數據庫洩漏的風險，同時保持了響應的準確性和相關性。<lb/>這項工作突顯了建立安全和可信的 RAG 系統的實用途徑。
